subject: Pilot -> Prod onramp: renewal economics & capacity amendment
messages:
From: Sophie Langston <sophie@retailflux.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot -> Prod uplift & renewal terms

Karthik,

Great news from our side — the pilot completed last week and model latency/accuracy metrics look good at scale. Engineering is green on deployment and product wants to move to production for the US commerce flows.

Before we push the button we need to lock renewal economics and capacity guarantees. Procurement and finance have a short list of asks:
- Can Redwood support a 12-month price hold if we increase committed usage by ~3x compared to the pilot baseline?
- Would you consider a one-time credit to offset pilot overage? We ran ~600k extra tokens during stress tests.
- Procurement needs a MAP (mutual action plan) and a target timeline for PO/SOW so our quarter close process can include this.

Legal also wants SOC2 evidence and a DPA reference included in any amendment. We have a small window to get this wrapped before our Q2 close. Can you do a 30-min slot this week? Friday afternoons work best for us.

Thanks,
Sophie Langston
Head of Product, RetailFlux

Attachments referenced: pilot-results-summary.xlsx, internal-test-logs.log

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Langston <sophie@retailflux.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot -> Prod uplift & renewal terms

Sophie — fantastic to hear the pilot metrics held up, congrats to your team. Were ready to move quickly on the commercial side. Attaching a short proposal (Renewal_Proposal_RevA.pdf) and a draft MAP for procurement. High-level commercial summary below: 

Proposal (Rev A) — commercial highlights:
- Committed uplift: target 3x pilot baseline (annualized). Staggered ramp to production: month 1 = 1.5x, month 2 = 2.2x, month 3+ = 3x to reduce execution risk.
- Price hold: 12-month token rate price hold from go-live conditional on execution of an amendment committing the uplift and receipt of PO within 45 days.
- Pilot credit: one-time $12,000 credit applied to the first invoice to offset pilot overage (ties to the ~600k tokens you referenced).
- Consumption buffer: 15% burst pool for first 90 days (no overage billing up to buffer).
- SLA: standard SLA preserved; in addition, 10% invoice credit for sustained latency breaches beyond SLO as defined in the SLA appendix.
- Billing: first invoice prorated to go-live week; pilot credit applied as a line item credit; standard net-30 terms.

A few important conditions we included to protect both sides:
1) Price hold requires the committed uplift amendment and PO as noted above.
2) If committed usage falls >25% below the ramp schedule after month 3, Redwood reserves the right to convert to a tiered pay-as-you-go rate (we included a reconciliation true-up at the 6-month mark).
3) SOC2/DPA references included in appendix; Ops will provide the SOC2 certificate and security evidence on request.

Next steps we propose:
- 30-min commercial sync (Im available Thu 11:00-12:30 or Fri 14:00-16:00 PT).
- Well upload the revision to DocuSign (preview link below) so your legal can redline.

Thanks — looping Vanessa to coordinate internal approvals and Marissa for any flexible concession authority.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: renewal_proposal_RevA.pdf, MAP-draft.docx, prop_terms_redlines_for_legal.pdf
Related link: https://redwood.app/docusign/preview/RF-2026-001

From: Sophie Langston <sophie@retailflux.com>

Cc: procurement@retailflux.com, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot -> Prod uplift & renewal terms

Thanks Karthik — review looks good at a glance. Two quick clarifications from procurement and finance (looping them in):
- Procurement: will the PO reference the amendment or the original MSA? We usually prefer amendment references so we can track budget.
- Finance: can the pilot credit be applied as either a dollar credit or as a one-time increased month-1 token allowance? Which is simpler for your billing ops?

Legal will upload an initial redline by end of day Friday if possible. Also: SOC2 + DPA — please send the cert link and a short security FAQ (we attach to the SOW for our auditors).

We can take Fri 14:00 PT for a quick sync. Sophie (procurement) and procurement@retailflux.com will join.

On the MAP: please include an ops onboarding milestone (app sandbox -> canary -> full prod) and responsibilities for Canary rollback thresholds.

Best,
Sophie

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: RetailFlux renewal approvals & concession window

Karthik/Marissa — quick internal note ahead of the Fri sync with RetailFlux. Ive reviewed Karthiks Rev A and cleared the following: 
- Pilot credit: approved at $12k one-time (apply as credit to invoice 1).
- Consumption buffer: 15% for 90 days approved.
- Price hold: we can offer a 12-month price hold conditioned on the committed uplift amendment + PO in 45 days (no further discount authority needed).

Open items that need fast sign-off from Marissa if procurement pushes back:
1) Extended price hold (>12 months) or deeper per-token discount: requires executive approval (Marissa, please confirm if you want this escalated).
2) If procurement asks to convert the pilot credit to a monthly recurring credit, we should deny — that materially reduces unit economics. Offer a larger burst pool instead if they push.
3) Legal redlines to prop_terms_redlines_for_legal.pdf: route to LegalOps; allow 48 hours turnaround target.

Risk notes: RetailFlux is strategic in commerce vertical but their GTM window is tight. If we stall past their quarter close they may delay go-live and conversion. Approve the credit and buffer now; Marissa please confirm escalation threshold re: longer price hold or additional discount.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Regional Sales Director, Redwood Inference
